introduction: Montana’s health application screens Medicaid and Healthy Montana Kids coverage. Public Assistance reviews eligibility for each applicant.
description: Montana’s health application screens Medicaid and Healthy Montana Kids coverage. Public Assistance reviews eligibility for each applicant.

sections.who: Age, income, household and program-category conditions matter. Explain pregnancy, disability or long-term-care needs.
sections.get: Approved applicants receive health coverage according to the program and decision notice.
sections.docs:
• Household and income details.
  • Existing insurance information.
  • Requested identity and eligibility records.
sections.apply:
1. Choose the application

    Visit DPHHS health application guidance.

  2. Apply for multiple needs

    For health, food and cash together, use apply.mt.gov or call 888-706-1535.

  3. Complete verification

    Save confirmation and respond to requested information.
sections.after: Read the coverage decision, follow renewal instructions and report changes.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Montana health application routes; Combined assistance portal. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Can I apply for children separately?
List the people needing coverage so their eligibility is screened.
Can I apply for food help too?
The shared application route supports combined requests.
Does one denial determine everyone’s eligibility?
Different family members can have different coverage categories.
No. Public Assistance reviews the case.
